homePostDiag.subtitle: Ready to plan your week? Let's set up your study schedule.

buildCard.title: Build your week plan
buildCard.sub: Pick days, assign topics, set your pace

auto.title1: Vidya made this plan for you
auto.body1Plain: I picked these topics from your warm-up. One topic a day, about 15 minutes.
auto.body2: Tap a day to pick a different topic. It's your week — you're in full control.
auto.body3: Happy with your week? Save it and we'll begin today's topic.
auto.body1_one: Your warm-up showed {{topics}} needs a little work, so that's where your week starts. One topic a day, about 15 minutes.
auto.body1_other: Your warm-up showed {{topics}} need some work, so your week covers all of them — one topic a day, about 15 minutes.

own.title1: Your week is empty — you're the boss
own.body1: You chose to pick your own topics, so I've left every day blank for you to fill.
own.title2: Tap a day to add a topic
own.body2: Pick a chapter, then the topic you want to study that day. Weekend days can stay free.
own.body3: Add as many days as you like, then save your week and we'll start.
